BroadcastEvent: A broadcast of a programme over the air or online. Also called airing, transmission, broadcast.
BusinessEvent: An event for business or professional purposes. Also called corporate event, business function. Examples: a trade meeting, a networking event.
ChildrensEvent: An event aimed at children. Also called kids' event, family event.
ComedyEvent: An event featuring comedy performance. Also called comedy show, stand-up gig.
ConferenceEvent: A formal gathering for presentations and discussion on a subject. Also called conference, convention, congress, symposium, summit.
CourseInstance: A specific scheduled offering of a course at a given time or place. Also called class session, course offering, intake.
DanceEvent: A social dance event. Also called dance, ball, dance party.
DeliveryEvent: An event marking the delivery of an item. Also called delivery, drop-off, dispatch.
EducationEvent: An event for teaching or learning. Also called class, workshop, seminar, lesson.
EventSeries: A set of related events sharing a theme, location, or organisers, often recurring. Also called series, recurring event, festival series. Examples: the Olympic Games.
ExhibitionEvent: An event displaying items, as at a museum, fair, or tradeshow. Also called exhibition, expo, show, fair.
Festival: A celebratory event or programme of performances, often cultural or seasonal. Also called fair, fete, celebration, carnival.
FoodEvent: An event centred on food or drink. Also called food festival, tasting, culinary event.
Hackathon: An event where people collaborate intensively on software or projects over a short period. Also called hack day, codefest, datathon.
LiteraryEvent: An event centred on literature, such as a reading or book fair. Also called book event, author reading, literary festival.
MusicEvent: An event featuring live or recorded music. Also called concert, gig, recital, show.
OnDemandEvent: A publication event making a programme available on demand. Also called catch-up, on-demand release, podcast drop.
PerformingArtsEvent: A live performance of music, theatre, dance, or spoken word. Also called show, performance, production, recital.
PublicationEvent: The event of publishing a creative work in any medium. Also called release, publication, broadcast.
SaleEvent: An event offering goods at reduced prices. Also called sale, promotion, clearance.
ScreeningEvent: A showing of a film or video. Also called screening, film showing, premiere.
SocialEvent: A gathering for social interaction. Also called party, get-together, social, function.
SportsEvent: An organised sporting competition or fixture. Also called game, match, fixture, tournament, race. Examples: a football match, a marathon.
TheaterEvent: A live theatrical performance. Also called play, theatre show, stage production.
VisualArtsEvent: An event centred on visual art, such as an exhibition opening. Also called art show, gallery opening, vernissage.
UserInteraction: A recorded interaction by a user with online content (legacy schema type). Also called user activity, engagement event.
UserBlocks: A count or record of users blocking content or other users (legacy). Also called blocks.
UserCheckins: A count or record of user check-ins at a place (legacy). Also called check-ins.
UserComments: A count or record of user comments on content (legacy). Also called comments.
UserDownloads: A count or record of user downloads (legacy). Also called downloads.
UserLikes: A count or record of user likes on content (legacy). Also called likes.
UserPageVisits: A count or record of user page visits (legacy). Also called page views, visits.
UserPlays: A count or record of user plays of media (legacy). Also called plays, streams.
UserPlusOnes: A count or record of user +1 endorsements (legacy). Also called plus-ones.
UserTweets: A count or record of user tweets about content (legacy). Also called tweets, posts.
